description: Ranked niches of Roblox (default) or Fortnite (platform=fortnite), hottest first by default: stage (forming, heating, crowded, dominated, established; Fortnite can be null with stageNote saying why), heat 0-100, opportunity window (open, narrowing, closing, or null with the days of history still needed), stage history, games, studios, players, new games in 14/30 days and how many reached 1,000 players (new30Winners), share held by the top game, median 24 h growth. Filter by stage, sort by any of these fields, page with nextCursor. Then call find_opportunities, analyze_niche or get_gap_analysis on a label. Every game carries asOf (export time, UTC), source and grade (grade = completeness of the game record (A = 8+ of 10 data points known, B = 6-7, C = 4-5, D = fewer); estimate grade: B = tighter range, C = wide range, D = very rough order of magnitude.) Revenue figures are estimates with a range and a grade, never measured sales and never a guarantee. Definitions: resource wieldr://methodology.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous call, to get the next page. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many results per page (default 10, max 30).

platform.description: steam, roblox, ios, itch (itch.io) or fortnite. Omit for all platforms.

sort.description: Field to sort by, descending. Default heat.

stage.description: Only niches at this stage (niches with an unknown stage are left out).

name: list_niches

dataset.description: full radar (member key or sign-in) or free preview (no key).

method.description: One useful sentence; full definitions in the MCP resource wieldr://methodology.

nextCursor.description: Pass it back as cursor for the next page; null = last page.

history.description: Daily niche history: first day, days recorded, first day seen at each stage (null in the free preview).

kind.description: tracked = ranked by the export; computed = live keyword computation over the moving pool (stage, heat, studios null).

stageNote.description: Why stage or heat is null (Fortnite: release dates still being tracked); null when both are known.

wieldrUrl.description: Public Wieldr page for this game or niche, to cite or link. Present only when the page exists (games of the free preview, ranked niches).
Public Wieldr page of a ranked niche, to cite or link; null for a computed niche (no page).

window.description: Cautious opportunity window from the daily niche history (estimate, not backtested); status null with daysNeeded under 15 days of history.

planNote.description: Creator plan only: fields left out of this answer because they are included in Pro, and where to see the plans.

planRequired.description: Present INSTEAD of the data when the tool, or this call, is not in the member's plan: nothing was looked up. Relay message and pricingUrl.

previewNote.description: Free preview only: what is missing, with real counts, and where to get the full radar.

title: List niches
